posts.title: Success metric is the hammer
posts.description: If you need just one metric to judge anything in your professional life, it's the success metric. Let's define the term so that we are on the same page: A success metric is a quantifiable measure you choose in advance to assess whether an effort has achieved its goal within a pre-defined timeline .
